title: cvpw timeline.json
description: The edit as data. Times are EXPRESSIONS resolved against the timebase, never bare numbers (docs/SPEC.md T2). See docs/CONTRACTS.md §8 and the grammar in §3.

note.description: Incidental prose about this file. Permitted so a generated artifact can say it is generated without inventing a key the schema rejects.

defaults.description: Applied to every shot that does not override them.

edges.description: Times that are intended hard cuts. Used to clamp motion-blur sub-frames and to classify a jump as planned during QA. A registered pixel seam must NOT appear here.

id.description: Unique. A block prefix is conventional so ownership is visible at a glance.

scene.description: Must be a registered scene, and `args` must satisfy its argsSchema.

style.description: Overrides project.json::style for this shot. Must be registered.

at.description: Time expression. e.g. "b(32,0)", "cue('chorus')+0.12", "L(12)", "VOX('sudden')", "p(0.85)". A bare number is permitted as seconds and raises a lint warning.

to.description: Optional end. Absent means 'until the next shot's at'; the last shot defaults to duration.

moment.description: One sentence: what this shot is FOR. Required (docs/SPEC.md C3) — the cheapest possible defence against filler.

block.description: Owning block id from docs/BLOCKS.md. Required when more than one author works on the film.

stateful.description: The scene carries simulation state and must be replayed deterministically via reset()/step(). Declared per shot, not per scene, because the same scene may be used both ways.

args.description: Validated against the scene's argsSchema. An unknown key is an error, never a default.

post.description: Merged over the style's post defaults. The last active shot's values win, so a transition does not average two unrelated grades.

transition.description: An overlap is owned by the LATER shot (docs/SPEC.md C1).

out.description: Seam id this shot hands off to, or null. Must match an entry in handoff.json.

text.description: On-screen strings. Every entry must appear verbatim in project.json::textWhitelist (docs/SPEC.md C6).

resolved.description: Written by `cvpw storyboard`: the expression resolved against the timebase. Kept beside `at` rather than replacing it, because a resolved number alone loses the reason the cut is there and an expression alone cannot be checked without the timebase.

t1.description: Resolved end in canonical seconds, exclusive.

blocks.description: The partition: disjoint time ranges with one owner each. Mirrors docs/BLOCKS.md.

from.description: Time expression for the block's start.

to.description: Time expression for the block's end.

entry.description: What is on screen at the first frame.

exit.description: What is on screen at the last frame.

handoffNext.description: What the next block must do at the boundary, and which shared values it must read.
